observations.notes: 9M26 rev $306.7m (+6.0% YoY; Q3 $99.8m +11.1% YoY), Adj EBITDA $102.7m (+2.3% YoY), GAAP net loss -$74.2m on SPAC transaction/SBC one-offs. Issued $425m 7.875% 2031 senior unsecured notes on 01-Oct-26; YE26E net leverage guided ~2.5x.

desk_verdict.recommendation: Neutral / Hold (Default risk low; capped by tobacco ESG exclusions and flavour regulations)

annotations.note: 9M26 rev $306.7m (+6%), Adj EBITDA $102.7m, cash $38.9m; $425m 7.875% Oct-31 notes issued 01-Oct-26; S&P BB- Stable.
Closed $425m 7.875% 2031 senior unsecured notes on 01-Oct-26 (S&P BB- Stable), repaying term loan & RCF; Q326 LTM Adj. EBITDA $141.6m, net debt $364.8m (2.6x), Nasdaq ticker AIIR.
Air Global generates high operating margins (34.5% EBITDA margin) across Gulf and European shisha tobacco and inhalation device retail networks, funding consistent positive FCF ( in 2024A).
Net leverage declined to 2.19x in 2024A. Stable consumer demand in core Middle East geographies supports robust interest coverage of 4.8x.

recovery_analysis.thesis: Consumer brand equity, distribution contracts across GCC, and high margin cash flow provide strong downside protection.

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Driven by Gulf hospitality volume recovery and retail channel expansion.
management_guidance_tracker.verification_question: What is the organic volume trajectory in Saudi Arabia and UAE retail?

management_questions.question: Quantify working capital release expected in Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 following Strait of Hormuz supply-chain rerouting.
Confirm net cash proceeds retained post-SPAC closing vs transaction expenses and OOKA investment ramp.
Confirm 2027 maintenance vs growth capex flexibility and free cash flow breakeven assumptions.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Post-Refinancing Shisha Leader (BB- Stable S&P, Nasdaq: AIIR)
verdict.summary: AIR Global completed its Nasdaq SPAC merger ($1.75bn EV) and issued $425m 7.875% Oct-31 senior unsecured notes on 01-Oct-26 (S&P BB- Stable) to term out bank debt. 9M26 revenue rose 6.0% YoY to $306.7m and Adj EBITDA reached $102.7m, though NWC inventory build on Strait of Hormuz routing cut cash to $38.9m ahead of Q1-27 dividend/buyback launch.

positives: Global market leader in shisha molasses (Al Fakher) and heat-not-burn (OOKA) with ~35% EBITDA margins and low capex (~3-4% of sales).
01-Oct-26 $425m 7.875% 2031 notes pushed out all major maturities to 2031 and replaced floating bank debt with fixed unsecured notes.
Completed Nasdaq listing (ticker AIIR) in 2026, improving governance disclosure and equity market access.
negatives: Leverage ticked up slightly to ~2.6x (net debt $364.8m / LTM EBITDA $141.6m) on Strait of Hormuz working capital & SPAC cash costs.
Tobacco/nicotine regulatory & excise tax headwinds across key European/MENA markets.
Financial sponsor heritage and potential post-listing M&A/shareholder return risk.

background.business_overview: Dubai-headquartered global leader in flavored shisha molasses (Al Fakher) and next-gen OOKA heated shisha devices, listed on Nasdaq (AIIR).
background.asset_perimeter: UAE manufacturing plants and global distribution across MEAA, Europe, and Americas (~99% hard-currency revenues).
background.ownership_governance: Publicly listed on US Nasdaq (AIIR) via 2026 SPAC merger (~$1.75bn valuation); S&P BB- Stable.

recent_drivers: Oct/Nov-26: Issued $425m 7.875% 2031 notes; S&P assigned BB- Stable; 9M26 rev $306.7m (+6%), Adj EBITDA $102.7m, YE26 net leverage guided ~2.5x.
01-Oct-26: Closed $425m 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031, fully repaying term loan & RCF.
Q3 2026: LTM Adj. EBITDA $141.6m, gross debt $403.7m, cash $38.9m, net debt $364.8m (2.6x); completed Nasdaq listing (AIIR).

catalysts.impact: Confirms normalization of Hormuz-related working capital and deleveraging back toward <2.2x.
Provides audited FY26 figures, updated leverage/capital print, and 2027 guidance for AIR Global PLC (Al Fakher / Advanced Inhalation Rituals).
